task.title: 添加托管 preference
task.shortdesc: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：添加托管 preference. Add a known managed preference that is not yet configured in the profile.

prereq.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：添加托管 preference. Open All Settings with the correct schema channel selected.

context.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：添加托管 preference. Managed preferences complement Firefox policies when BPM exposes a known preference key and lock behavior. Add them deliberately and validate the result.

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：添加托管 preference. Open the add preference control or find the preference in Catalog mode.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：添加托管 preference. Choose the known preference key and review its expected value type.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：添加托管 preference. Enter the value and lock state required by the profile.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：添加托管 preference. Apply, validate, and save the managed preference.

info.note: 警告：保存前请检查架构、值来源以及更改后果。

result.p: All Settings 显示配置文件的预期状态，并且该操作可在审查时解释。 The profile contains the new managed preference with the intended value and lock behavior.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请清除筛选器、返回详细信息面板或打开相关主题。 Recovery: if the preference key is unknown or validation fails, remove the draft value and use JSON only for deliberate raw review.
